A '''packet of information''' was an important item that [[Sei Taria/Legends|Sei Taria]] tried to obtain in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]. [[Sei Taria's contact]] in a [[Trade Federation brokerage house]] on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] offered to sell her the packet. Taria then sent [[Sei Taria's troubleshooters|her troubleshooter team]], but the contact was dead before they arrived.
